meta.subtitle: Cupertino (ZIP 95014) and San Francisco (ZIP 94122) · anonymized
meta.privacy: No personal information appears on this site. All identities, street addresses, trust names and account numbers are replaced with placeholders; only city and ZIP-code-level geography is used.
meta.rounding: All dollar amounts are rounded to the nearest $10.
meta.verification: Every data-table row carries a link to an official government source. Values that cannot be confirmed are left blank and flagged. Official values, client inputs and model outputs are three separate, labelled categories.

IRS_ESTATE.title: Estate tax (filing thresholds by year of death)
IRS_ESTATE.note: Gross-estate definition; 2026 Form 706 filing threshold $15,000,000; portability election.

IRS_ESTATE_FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions on estate taxes
IRS_ESTATE_FAQ.note: Public Law 119-21 raised the basic exclusion to $15,000,000 for 2026; Form 706 due 9 months after death; 6-month extension via Form 4768; DSUE portability.

CONGRESS_HR1.title: H.R.1, Public Law 119-21, text (Sec. 70106)
CONGRESS_HR1.note: Sec. 70106 replaces $5,000,000 with $15,000,000; inflation indexing for years beginning after 2026.

CONGRESS_HR1_SUM.title: H.R.1 summary, Public Law 119-21 (07/04/2025)
CONGRESS_HR1_SUM.note: Increases the base estate, gift and GST exemption after 2025 to $15 million, adjusted for inflation.

IRS_RP2532.title: Revenue Procedure 2025-32 (2026 inflation adjustments)
IRS_RP2532.note: 2026 long-term capital gain 0%/15% thresholds (MFJ $98,900 / $613,700); 2026 annual gift exclusion $19,000; estates/trusts 20% rate above $16,250.

IRS_I706.title: Instructions for Form 706 (07/2026)
IRS_I706.note: Estate tax is levied on the entire taxable estate, not on a beneficiary's share; top unified rate 40%; estate/GST tax due within 9 months.

IRS_P551.title: Publication 551, Basis of Assets
IRS_P551.note: Basis of inherited property is generally FMV at date of death (or alternate valuation date); §1014(f) consistency rule.

IRS_INHERIT_FAQ.title: Gifts & inheritances (IRS FAQ)
IRS_INHERIT_FAQ.note: Inherited-property basis is FMV at death whether or not Form 706 is filed; gain on later sale is taxable.

IRS_P525.title: Publication 525, Taxable and Nontaxable Income
IRS_P525.note: Generally, property received as a gift, bequest or inheritance is not included in income; later interest, dividends or rents are taxable.

IRS_TC701.title: Topic no. 701, Sale of your home
IRS_TC701.note: §121 exclusion up to $250,000 ($500,000 joint); ownership and use 2 of the 5 years before sale; no exclusion if another home was excluded in prior 2 years.

IRS_P523.title: Publication 523, Selling Your Home
IRS_P523.note: Rules for home inherited from a decedent; business or rental use, nonqualified use after 2008, and basis adjustments.

IRS_TC409.title: Topic no. 409, Capital gains and losses
IRS_TC409.note: 0% / 15% / 20% rates; 25% maximum on unrecaptured §1250 gain; short-term gains at ordinary rates.

IRS_TC559.title: Topic no. 559, Net investment income tax
IRS_TC559.note: 3.8% NIIT; $250,000 MFJ / $200,000 single MAGI thresholds; rents and gains from real estate generally included; §121-excluded gain is not.

IRS_P527.title: Publication 527, Residential Rental Property
IRS_P527.note: Rental income, deductible expenses, depreciation, repairs vs. improvements, and sale of a main home used as rental property.

IRS_FS1031.title: Like-Kind Exchanges Under IRC Section 1031 (FS-2008-18)
IRS_FS1031.note: §1031 applies only to business/investment real property; primary residences, stocks, bonds, notes and securities do not qualify.

IRS_P544.title: Publication 544, Sales and Other Dispositions of Assets
IRS_P544.note: Like-kind exchange nonrecognition rules apply only to real property held for investment or business use.

IRS_TC503.title: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes
IRS_TC503.note: SALT deduction limited to $40,000 ($20,000 MFS), subject to MAGI limitation, floor $10,000.

IRS_SALT2026.title: Correction to 2026 Form 1040-ES SALT amount
IRS_SALT2026.note: 2026 SALT limit $40,400 ($20,200 MFS); reduced above MAGI $505,000 ($252,500 MFS); floor $10,000.

IRS_F1041ES.title: Form 1041-ES 2026, Estimated Income Tax for Estates and Trusts
IRS_F1041ES.note: 2026 estates/trusts: 20% capital-gain rate above $16,250; NIIT 3.8% on undistributed net investment income.

IRS_P559.title: Publication 559, Survivors, Executors and Administrators
IRS_P559.note: Duties of the personal representative, final Form 1040, Form 56, and estate/trust income tax reporting.

FED_FOMC.title: Statement on Longer-Run Goals and Monetary Policy Strategy (reaffirmed 2026)
FED_FOMC.note: FOMC longer-run inflation goal is 2 percent (PCE). This is a policy goal, not a forecast through 2050.

FHFA_HPI.title: FHFA House Price Index datasets
FHFA_HPI.note: Official repeat-sales house price indexes at metro-area, county and ZIP-code level; used as the official anchor for appreciation scenarios.

HUD_FMR.title: FY 2026 Schedule of Fair Market Rents
HUD_FMR.agency: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
HUD_FMR.note: CA metropolitan FMRs: San Jose-Sunnyvale-Santa Clara HMFA 4-BR $5,010/mo; San Francisco HMFA 4-BR $4,770/mo (official figure, rounded to the nearest $10). Program benchmark, not a property appraisal.

COURTS_TRUST.title: Probate Trusts — trustee duties when the settlor dies
COURTS_TRUST.agency: California Courts (Santa Clara County Superior Court)
COURTS_TRUST.note: Successor trustee acceptance; written notice to beneficiaries/heirs within 60 days; inventory and appraisal; estate tax returns and payment within 9 months; new trust TIN; trust income tax returns.

COURTS_LIVING.title: Living Trusts (self-help)
COURTS_LIVING.agency: California Courts (Santa Clara County Superior Court)
COURTS_LIVING.note: A funded living trust avoids probate; successor trustee distributes without court supervision; pour-over will used for unfunded assets.

BOE_PROP19.title: Proposition 19 (official BOE page and comparison charts)
BOE_PROP19.note: Current law: principal residence of transferor AND transferee; value limit of current taxable value + $1,000,000 (biennially adjusted); homeowners' exemption within 1 year; claim within 3 years; R&T Code §63.2.

BOE_P801.title: Proposition 19 Fact Sheet (Publication 801)
BOE_P801.note: Date of death is the date of transfer; transferee must occupy as principal residence within 1 year; adjusted value limit $1,044,590 for 2/16/2025-2/15/2027; forms BOE-19-P, BOE-19-G, BOE-266, BOE-261-G.

BOE_P800_9.title: Death of a Real Property Owner — Reporting Requirements (Publication 800-9)
BOE_P800_9.note: Death is a change in ownership as of date of death even when property is held in a trust; BOE-502-D filed within 150 days; BOE-19-P / BOE-19-G / BOE-58-H claims; reassessment to market value unless an exclusion applies.

BOE_P800_10.title: How Property Is Assessed for Property Tax Purposes (Publication 800-10)
BOE_P800_10.note: Assessed value less exemptions multiplied by the tax rate; homeowners' exemption reduces assessed value by $7,000.

BOE_502D.title: Sample BOE-502-D, Change in Ownership Statement — Death of a Real Property Owner
BOE_502D.note: Trustee/transferee files within 150 days of death; 18 CCR 462.260(c) sets date of change in ownership at date of death.

SCC_PROP13.title: Understanding Proposition 13
SCC_PROP13.note: 1% rate limit, assessed-value growth no greater than 2% annually, reassessment at market value on change of ownership; additional voter-approved taxes may raise the rate.

SCC_RATEBOOK.title: Property Tax Rate Book (archive, incl. FY2025-26)
SCC_RATEBOOK.note: Official TRA-specific rates; 816 tax rate areas in FY2025-26; 1.00000% maximum levy plus voter-approved bond rates; supplemental bills after change in ownership.

SCC_RATEPDF.title: County of Santa Clara Compilation of Tax Rates & Information, FY2025-2026
SCC_RATEPDF.note: 1.00000% maximum levy plus bond rates; assessed value increases by CCPI or 2%, whichever is less; direct/special assessments are separate.

SCC_ANNUAL.title: Santa Clara County Assessor Annual Report 2025-2026
SCC_ANNUAL.note: 2025-26 CCPI 2.514% produced the maximum 2% assessed-value increase; death of an owner is a reassessable change in ownership; trust-held property reassessed at date of death.

SF_ASSESSOR.title: Learn about real property assessments
SF_ASSESSOR.note: 1% rate plus voter-approved bond indebtedness and direct assessments; assessment growth capped at inflation or 2%, whichever is lower.

SF_TREASURER.title: Secured Property Taxes
SF_TREASURER.note: FY2026-27 secured property tax rate 1.18162182%; supplemental and escape assessments after a change in ownership; total due includes direct charges/special assessments.

SCO_ESTATE.title: California Estate Tax
SCO_ESTATE.note: For decedents dying on or after January 1, 2005, no California Estate Tax Return is required.

SCO_RTC13301.title: Estate Tax and GST Tax Laws (R&T Code §13301)
SCO_RTC13301.note: §13301: neither the state nor any political subdivision may impose any gift, inheritance, succession, legacy, income or estate tax on a transfer occurring by reason of death.

FTB_FEDCHANGES.title: Summary of Federal Income Tax Changes
FTB_FEDCHANGES.note: California does not provide special rates for net capital gain; gains are taxed at ordinary income rates of 1% to 12.3%.

FTB_RATES.title: 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules
FTB_RATES.note: Top California personal income tax rate 12.30% on the highest bracket.

FTB_540ES.title: 2025 Instructions for Form 540-ES
FTB_540ES.note: Additional 1% tax on California taxable income over $1,000,000 (Behavioral Health Services Tax), making the top marginal rate 13.3%.

SOS_BALLOT.title: Qualified Statewide Ballot Measures — November 3, 2026
SOS_BALLOT.note: 14 measures qualified, including Prop. 3 (extends high-income tax), Prop. 40 (one-time tax on certain taxpayers), Prop. 42 (prohibits new state personal property taxes), Prop. 43 (limits local revenue measures).

SOS_CERTIFIES.title: Secretary of State certifies measures for Nov. 3, 2026 ballot
SOS_CERTIFIES.note: Prop. 3 would make permanent the 2012 high-income tax rates otherwise expiring in 2031; estimated $5B-$15B annual state income tax maintained.

SOS_PROP40.title: Official Voter Information Guide — Proposition 40
SOS_PROP40.note: One-time tax measure; SOS news release describes up to 5% on covered assets over $1 billion, excluding real property.

SOS_RESULTS.title: State Ballot Measures — unofficial statewide results, Nov. 3, 2026
SOS_RESULTS.note: Unofficial results as of Nov. 9, 2026 (23,860 of 23,860 precincts partially reporting): Prop. 3 Yes 60.6%, Prop. 40 No 52.8%, Prop. 42 Yes 51.6%, Prop. 43 No 57.3%. Results certified by Dec. 11, 2026.

SOS_RESULTS_FAQ.title: Election results FAQ — November 3, 2026
SOS_RESULTS_FAQ.note: County results due December 4, 2026; Secretary of State compiles and certifies results by December 11, 2026.

SF_RENT.title: Learn about rent increases in San Francisco
SF_RENT.agency: City and County of San Francisco (Rent Board)
SF_RENT.note: For covered units the allowable annual rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

CDI_AVG.title: Sustainable Insurance Strategy — California market snapshot
CDI_AVG.note: California average homeowner premium $1,570 (national $1,510); page updated October 27, 2026. Statewide average, not ZIP-specific.

CDI_REPORT.title: Residential Property Insurance Report
CDI_REPORT.note: CDI collects ZIP-code-level earned premiums, coverage amounts and losses by policy form; reports cover dwelling-fire, homeowners multi-peril, renters and condo policies.

CDI_TOOL.title: 2026 Homeowners Insurance premium comparison tool
CDI_TOOL.note: Annual premiums effective May 1, 2026; lists 'SANTA CLARA CUPERTINO' and 'SAN FRANCISCO SAN FRANCISCO-Sunset District'; explicitly not a quote.

CPUC_SB695.title: 2025 Senate Bill 695 Report (net energy metering)
CPUC_SB695.note: New solar customers from April 2023 receive the Net Billing Tariff; NEM 1.0/2.0 legacy 20-year periods remain in effect when a property with a NEM system changes hands.

CPUC_VNEM.title: Virtual Net Energy Metering / Net Billing Tariff
CPUC_VNEM.note: Decision D.22-12-056 adopted the net billing tariff; NEM 2.0 sunset April 14, 2023; legacy period rules.

CPUC_WATER.title: San Jose Water Company tariff (Cupertino service territory)
CPUC_WATER.note: CPUC tariff schedules list 'portions of Cupertino' in the regulated water service territory; meter and quantity rates are tariff-based, not a fixed monthly bill.

SFPUC_RATES.title: Rates Schedules and Fees (2026-27 water, sewer, power)
SFPUC_RATES.note: Official rate schedules for water/sewer and Hetch Hetchy Power / CleanPowerSF.

SFPUC_218.title: Proposition 218 notice for proposed water and sewer rates
SFPUC_218.note: Approved average single-family water/sewer bill increase of about 8.3% per year; rates are set by tariff, not by a fixed monthly bill.

process.title: Step-by-step inheritance of Property A through a trust

cells: Confirm the property is titled in the trust (funding)
A living trust only avoids probate for assets actually transferred into it; a pour-over will catches unfunded assets.
Document whether the home is the transferor's principal residence
Prop 19 requires the family home to be the principal residence of BOTH transferor and transferee. This single fact determines whether a reassessment exclusion is even possible.
Successor trustee signs Acceptance of Trusteeship; trust becomes irrevocable
Trustee takes over without probate court supervision when the trust is funded.
Written notice to all beneficiaries and heirs (Prob. Code §16061.7)
Notice must include trustee contact, place of administration, and the right to request a copy of the trust; 120-day contest period follows.
Date-of-death appraisal / inventory of all estate assets
Needed to establish fair market value for basis and to determine whether estate tax returns are required.
Property-tax change in ownership occurs on the date of death
Applies to trust-held property even if the deed to beneficiaries is recorded years later; reassessment to market value unless an exclusion applies.
File BOE-502-D with the county assessor for each parcel
Trustee or transferee files; if probated, file with the inventory and appraisal. Penalties may apply on an assessor's request.
Beneficiary occupies the home as principal residence
Required for the Prop 19 intergenerational exclusion. Later occupancy does not qualify retroactively.
File homeowners' exemption (BOE-266) or disabled veterans' exemption (BOE-261-G)
Timely filing gives the exclusion as of the date of transfer; late filing gives prospective relief only.
Must be filed before transfer to a third party; also timely if within 6 months of a supplemental/escape assessment notice.
Assessor issues supplemental / escape assessment at market value
Supplemental bills are in addition to the regular annual bill; SF also publishes escape-assessment procedures.
File Form 706 if gross estate + adjusted taxable gifts > $15,000,000 (2026)
Estate tax is on the estate, not the beneficiary; top rate 40%; 6-month extension via Form 4768.
Obtain a new TIN for the trust and file Form 1041 for post-death income
Interest, dividends and rents earned after death are taxable to the estate/trust or to beneficiaries.
Record the deed / affidavit and update the tax mailing address
The tax bill mailing address is unchanged until the assessor is notified.
Basis in the real property = FMV at date of death
A stepped-up basis normally eliminates gain on an immediate sale; later appreciation is taxable.
Choose: occupy, rent, or sell and reinvest
See the Decision Analysis page; a sale reinvested in stocks cannot use §1031 deferral.
If sold after 2 years of ownership + use
§121 may exclude up to $250,000 ($500,000 joint) of gain
Ownership and use tests are 2 out of the 5 years before sale; nonqualified use and depreciation rules apply.
Confirm the NEM / Net Billing Tariff legacy period transfers with the property
CPUC states legacy periods remain in effect when a property with a NEM system changes hands.
